text.title: Roach
text.nearby: A school of roach swims by.
text.about_looks: A silvery fish with red eyes and reddish fins.
text.about_food: Water insects, snails and water plants.
text.about_home: Swims in big schools in lakes, often near the shore.
text.about_winter: Moves to deeper water in schools and is slow and quiet under the ice.
text.about_young: Spawns in late spring in shallow, weedy water.
text.about_fact: The roach is one of the most common fish in Finnish lakes. Pike and perch love to eat it.

year.shelter: Shoals in deeper water in winter, slow and quiet under the ice.
year.young: Spawns in May–June in shallow, weedy water.

food.winter: Eats very little under the ice.
